system.description:
Grants the ability to give attributes to a target.

  • Level 1: Transfer 1 Attribute
  • Level 2: Transfer 2 Attributes
  • Level 3: Transfer 3 Attributes
  • Level 4: Transfer Attributes up to Level 4
  • Level 5: Transfer Attributes up to Level 5
  • Level 6: Transfer Attributes up to Level 6
